verdict.rationale: Hightouch's first-party MCP server lets an AI assistant build audiences in plain language, with a documented natural-language audience-creation example, and it exposes tools to understand the customer schema. Together these support schema-grounded AI segment building, and the built-in agent can also explore segments in natural language. Missing for 10: an explicit review/approval step for AI-generated segment definitions before they are saved, documentation that the built-in agent itself (not only the MCP route) creates segment definitions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
